item.title: More Americans Want Brands To Get Political
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260219170819_021926IPSOS.webp" alt="ipsos" />Most Americans believe companies should remain neutral on political and social issues, but new findings suggest that a growing number now think it's appropriate for brands to make political statements and to take a similar stand on racial-justice issues.</p>

item.title: OMC’s Wren Closes Books on IPG Deal
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260219101711_020425JohnWren.webp" alt="JOhn Wren" />Omnicom CEO John Wren reported a Q4 $977.2M operating loss, largely due to the $1.1B in severance and repositioning expenses connected to the $13B Interpublic takeover that closed on Nov. 26.</p>
